Lore

A creature spawned as a corruption of pact magic, designed to hunt familiar bonds. The Unfamiliar instinctively tracks anyone who has ever summoned a familiar and pursues them with priority. Its type varies (Celestial, Fey, or Fiend) depending on origin, but behaviour is consistent: hostile, target-locked, and magically erratic.

Source: Pointy Hat
